description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between S. R. T. P. Sinhabahu and National Aquatic Resources Research & Development Agency. - Industrial Dispute between G. H. N. Shyamali and Land Reform Commission
categorisation: This gazette content contains orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. Specifically, it includes ministerial orders appointing arbitrators to settle industrial disputes between individuals and government agencies, exercising powers vested by existing legislation. This falls under legal/regulatory gazettes as it deals with statutory instruments and the implementation of labor laws, rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
